execution_recovery_14.continuation: All received revision 12 and 13 replies are bound by exact prompt/schema/family/stage and referenced under their original protocol. The original zero-byte retry is already resolved; no further retry of it is authorized.
execution_recovery_14.forward_proof: The October 20 intraday proof remains revision 13 and is scored under its immutable registered freeze, never relabeled.
execution_recovery_14.quota: A stopped family is resubmitted after its own reset even while the other worker continues. Daily cap stops resume after UTC rollover. No recorded answer is redispatched.
execution_recovery_14.reason: Measured forward GPT latency exceeded four minutes. Regular forward workers must run concurrently with their full 900-second timeout and at least 900 seconds remaining; the 20-minute dispatch window ends before the earliest 09:30 entry. Forward crypto uses T+25 minutes; replay crypto remains T+15 minutes.

execution_recovery_15.dry_run: Read-only scheduled dispatch preflight: committed freeze and input seals, expected commit, subscription grant, per-family stop and reservation gates. Zero requests, model calls or publications. Future live receipts and provider availability remain unproven.
execution_recovery_15.news: Uniformly for both families, replay and forward: a missing candidate view becomes ABSTAIN, p_outperform 0.5, no news_ids, no trade; count filled views. Duplicate and unknown symbols stay invalid; all candidate x horizon forecasts remain mandatory. Prompts and model-facing schemas unchanged.
execution_recovery_15.reset: Honor structured resets or the next printed Codex try-again/Claude resets clock, including dated forms. A notice inside its truncated minute expires at the end of that minute. Reparse saved usage-limit evidence; no reset without a saved message, no budget refund.
execution_recovery_15.scoring: Resolve original response bytes through the digest-bound continuation source, verify the envelope digest and published response hash. Current stores retain current spec/code checks.

execution_recovery_16.anonymous_clock: Only the anonymous analyst schema accepts exact DAY+/-n HH:MM:SS UTC citation clocks. Validate known (coded clock, URL) pairs without ISO parsing; no invented real dates. Reuse original admitted anonymous answers with the original request/schema identity and explicit compatibility metadata. Such original-schema controls stay marked as diagnostic. Regular and forward schemas and prompts are unchanged.
execution_recovery_16.failure_reporting: Log the validation code and source call identity for each failed attempt, including failures before semantic validation. Idempotent replay of the same saved attempt never increments failure counts. Every score includes per-model and per-group MODEL_FAILURE cells / resolved cells, rate and planned count; valid forecasts of the other model remain in its own scores and common keys alone enter paired tests.
execution_recovery_16.first_pair: Only the first attempt pair per family/period/group/day/stage is admitted. A stage with two validation failures makes the entire cell MODEL_FAILURE: no forecast or trade, durable terminal marker, advance to the next day. Quota, unknown outcome and integrity errors remain blocking. Any later re-ask is private and never admitted, graded or used.
execution_recovery_16.invalid_input_diagnosis: Opus dev anonymous July 1: analyst validator tried datetime.fromisoformat on a coded context headline clock, even for an all-ABSTAIN response. ValueError escaped the worker to the generic INVALID_OR_MISSING_INPUT CLI error.
execution_recovery_16.july13_diagnosis: GPT news dev July 13 first try0 and try1 each fail CITATION_NOT_IN_SNAPSHOT: IDs belong to another supplied candidate. No schema/type mismatch; no citation rule relaxed. Two real calls and eleven revalidations of the same pair, not twenty-two real calls.

execution_recovery_17.first_pair: An unresolved first pair with recorded bytes or an exhausted zero-byte retry becomes MODEL_FAILURE, no forecasts or trades, never re-asked. A dead zero-byte INTENT retains its one retry. Active owners, integrity failures, quotas and credit stops remain independent gates.

execution_recovery_17.scoring: All declared metrics, baselines, costs, exclusions and primary bootstrap protocol unchanged. No test outcomes inspected for this amendment.
execution_recovery_17.test_continuation: Preserve both original v12 published start markers and the completed development score by digest. Revalidate original responses only; publish a distinct v13 continuation marker before new test dispatches. Verify each old test response against its original start publication.
execution_recovery_17.window: Replay dispatch only at 20:30..06:55 UTC, full 900 seconds before 07:00; last full-timeout start 06:45. Check in code before every reservation. Forward keeps its separate window.

forward.input_rule: Same declared filters and blanket shared exclusions, with counts. Source receipts strictly before T; immutable common snapshot. Missing required live data excludes that day; never reuse a historical snapshot.

intraday_recovery.crypto: Forecasts retained; first crypto trade unavailable under the unchanged bars-only grant, so crypto trade labels excluded explicitly without substituting minute opens.
intraday_recovery.decision_time: Common actual completion time of both decisions; earlier immutable input_cutoff stored separately. No future input is admitted.
intraday_recovery.entry: First actual SIP trade strictly after T+30 seconds, within the declared one-second fill coverage; no trade means no fabricated fill. Hashes on Discord and the pushed ledger strictly before T+30 seconds or BLOCKED.
intraday_recovery.exit: Unchanged: fixed-universe 1d at close minus five minutes; other stock horizons at their declared session close.
intraday_recovery.resume: No second model dispatch or new decision clock after an attempted recovery; a crash blocks.

news_coverage.collector: Bootstrap from the earliest possible prebuild lookback. Then query only from the verified contiguous news watermark minus 300 seconds through the actual poll start. Advance coverage only after complete pagination is durably indexed; preserve overlapping versions and first receipts. Fetch daily histories only for newly encountered symbols. Same 2000 input / 3000 total daily request ceilings and rate limits.
news_coverage.decision_window: Previous exchange close through the immutable input cutoff.
news_coverage.rule: LIVE_FORWARD only: union complete all-symbol pagination intervals. Gaps outside the decision window exclude only affected news items. A gap within that window excludes only affected items when at most 1800 seconds and not covering the entire decision window; otherwise exclude the day. Record exact intervals and partial availability identically for both families. Never invent missing news or relax receipt, creation/update, integrity, metadata, history or pipeline checks.

prebuild.cache: Immutable canonical-hash-addressed snapshot, atomic ready pointer, matching session/spec/code. At dispatch admit only fresh verified cache. Corruption blocks; missing, expired or old-binding cache triggers a new build at the scheduled 09:05 cutoff.
prebuild.collector_lock: Wait for an already running poll until at most 08:55 New York; use actual lock-acquired build time as cutoff. Never read an index while collection can rewrite its objects.
prebuild.cutoff: Actual prebuild start; receipt, created/updated news and completed-bar clocks remain strictly before this cutoff. Scheduled decision and entry anchors remain 09:05 and their original offsets.
prebuild.dispatch: Concurrent one-call workers, unchanged 900s timeout and 20-minute window. Require at least the call timeout at the actual subprocess launch. No extension past the 09:30 New York publication deadline.
prebuild.drill: 22:45 UTC offline build/write/read rehearsal from the latest collected session; verify next-session gates, measure fallback headroom and alert alertes if less than timeout remains. Zero requests, model calls or publications.
prebuild.gates: Before READY check every shared day-exclusion, saved decision/failure, durable model budget, usage/credit stop, grant and API billing gate using the scheduled dispatch clock. BLOCKED and alert alertes for any model skip. Repeat gates after construction. Drill applies next-session gates plus the same exclusions to its offline source snapshot. Future receipts and provider availability remain unproven.
prebuild.schedule: 08:45 America/New_York on exchange weekdays (12:45 UTC during EDT)

Forward is reported separately from replay. The scorer checks the frozen forward configuration hashes, the first session and the publication receipts; failed days are reported with counts.
forward.weekly: Friday 17:15 America/New_York, cumulative matured paired counts, per-panel Brier/log-loss to configured notify executable in channel brouillons, durable at-most-once delivery intent.

forward_score_repair.legacy: Resolve each snapshot against its registered original freeze and canonical source spec, including original crypto offset and costs. All original publication gates remain mandatory.
forward_score_repair.query_bounds: Collector and scorer use stable daily-query ends at each label maturity, independent of scoring wall clock. No URL alias, partial-coverage substitution or invented fill.
forward_score_repair.scope: Implementation and reporting correction; original decision, entry, exit, cost, label, exclusion and statistical rules remain authoritative.

forward_window_repair.alerts: Existing hyprl-notify alertes route for prebuild/drill failure and dispatch headroom below call timeout.

forward_window_repair.scope: Research execution only. Prebuild before dispatch; preserve stricter causal input cutoff independently of scheduled entry anchor. No changes to model identities, schemas, horizon definitions, costs, exclusions, statistics or historical records.

information_snapshot.archive: Request URL hashes, compressed cache hashes, receipt times and pagination remain bound and verified. Missing or contradictory data coverage excludes the affected symbol or day under the blanket rule. Raw SIP bars only; adjusted bars reserved for scoring. UUID-only asset duplication remains compatible.
information_snapshot.daily_bars: SIP adjustment=raw, timestamp < T and bar interval completed strictly before T; crypto raw completed UTC daily bars. Indicators from those bars only; labels from same raw series after T.
information_snapshot.news: Alpaca/Benzinga created_at < T and updated_at < T, both strict (operator decision 2026-10-18 replaces the 24 h edit tolerance); only headline, source, symbols, created_at. No summaries, bodies, raw URLs or authors; opaque generated citation IDs. Missing clocks are rejected. Items whose updated_at precedes created_at are uniformly excluded and counted; captured data are never repaired. Missing, invalid and contradictory required fields/clocks are excluded uniformly and counted.
information_snapshot.rule: Every input is canonical-hashed by id/content, cut off strictly before T, built for all dev/test days before calls and sealed by a committed digest. Models only read these bundles.
information_snapshot.sec: EDGAR acceptance upper bound < T; preserve conservative New York/UTC ambiguity handling. No filing accepted at T is shown.
information_snapshot.universe: Fixed v1 configured 2026-10-08, instruments with bar history before 2026-07-01. News equity candidates: >=200 prior completed sessions and arithmetic mean of last 50 close*volume >=10M USD; active and inactive assets included when history exists. Retain top-40 headline-keyword/recency rank and exclusions of fixed names and known ETFs. A candidate-history bar query must reach at least 365 calendar days (>= 250 sessions) before T.
information_snapshot.vintage: Operator-declared approximate method, not original-vintage evidence. All outputs carry APPROXIMATE_POINT_IN_TIME and residual risks.

purpose: Research-only declared approximate vendor-archive replay (EXPLORATORY) and isolated prospective forward duel (LIVE_FORWARD, the only proof); no orders or training.

statistics.base_rate: Laplace (wins+1)/(n+2) per variant/fixed horizon. Dev uses only labels whose exit is strictly before that decision. Test uses a rate fixed from censored Jul-Aug dev labels before any test call; no test fitting.
statistics.ess: cluster/day Kish and day ICC design effect for forecast loss and trade returns; paired independent-block count also reported
statistics.frozen_dev_base_rate: Laplace rate from dev a:1d target counts and a digest of the underlying labels, committed in the configuration freeze before any call; independent of model outputs Missing exact fills remain counted and cannot be fabricated.
limitations: Only 21 test sessions; up to three 10-session blocks, coarse paired p-values. No general superiority claim from an underpowered replay.
Latent model memory cannot be ruled out by non-flagging probes.
Crypto 5d and boundary-crossing outcomes excluded with counts; missing or invalid eligible fills/marks are uniformly excluded and counted.
Wilson intervals are descriptive and ignore clustering; ESS is diagnostic, not a proof of independence.
Approximate archives are never presented as original-vintage evidence. Small/mid remains a news/liquidity proxy, with no historical market-cap assertion.
headline text is the vendor's latest version, last edited before T
universe survivorship for names without Alpaca history
asset borrow flags are the collection-time values, not point-in-time
Replay results are EXPLORATORY: the design was chosen after the test window was seen.
statistics.paired_test: Exact two-sided block sign-flip on daily mean Opus-minus-GPT Brier and log loss, all same instruments/days/horizons paired, nonoverlapping blocks of 10 NYSE sessions anchored at period start; Holm correction over all named panel/loss comparisons. No trade-conditioned probability selection.
statistics.pnl: fixed initial equity; equal weights within actual entry cohorts; max horizon capital divisor 1/5/10; mark daily, costs charged on entry/exit; calendar days including zeros, Sharpe annualization sqrt(365)

statistics.primary_samples: Each model CI uses its own complete forecast sample; the paired difference uses common instrument/session keys and identical target labels. Missing exchange sessions keep their calendar position in the bootstrap.
statistics.reporting: every report shows the full table, failure counts and the primary endpoint; winner wording only if the paired 95% CI excludes 0
